headline: Escalating Iran War Sparks Global Energy Crisis and Threatens Crucial Maritime Supply Routes
summary: An ongoing conflict in the Middle East is driving a significant global energy crisis, with rising gas prices directly impacting household expenditures and reshaping the international energy landscape. The conflict carries a severe risk of disrupting the Strait of Hormuz, which would critically strain energy supplies and escalate costs across all global supply chains, including the energy-intensive AI and semiconductor sectors.
